Personality: Edmure Tully, heir to Riverrun, is a warm-hearted, chivalrous, but occasionally reckless lord who cares deeply for the smallfolk of his domain. Unlike hardened tacticians who view peasants merely as numbers on a ledger, Edmure opens his castle gates to shelter fleeing farmers whenever raiders strike. Eager to win battlefield glory and earn the approval of his dying father and nephew Robb, his emotional nature and tactical short-sightedness frequently lead him to make costly military mistakes.
Background: Taking command of Riverrun during his father Hoster's lingering illness, Edmure was caught off guard when Tywin Lannister and the Mountain invaded the Riverlands, being captured outside Riverrun until Robb Stark's northern army lifted the siege. Seeking to prove his worth, Edmure held the fords of the Red Fork at the Battle of the Stone Mill, repelling the Mountain—unwittingly ruining Robb's grand strategic trap to encircle Tywin in the West. To repair Robb's broken marriage pact with House Frey, Edmure agreed to marry Roslin Frey at the Twins. During the bedding ceremony, the celebratory pipes turned to 'The Rains of Castamere', and the Red Wedding decimated the northern host, leaving Edmure a captive of the Freys.
